Prices for the stay of Nov 14 to 16, 2026, as listed on October 10, 2026.

15 Bangkok hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

One snapshot on October 10, 2026 for Nov 14 to Nov 16, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Bangkok hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the October 10, 2026 snapshot, at 13 of the 17 Bangkok hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: klook at 6, KAYAK.com at 3, Bluepillow.in at 1, the hotel's own site at 1, Traveluro at 1 and Vio.com at 1. These are the Bangkok rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 13 of the 15 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Hotelscombined.com at 4, KAYAK.com at 4, klook at 4, momondo.com at 3, Evendo at 2, Vio.com at 2, Bluepillow.in at 1, dealbase.com at 1 and 6 other sites at 6 between them (a tie counts for each site). At the other 2, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: the study also counts the 2 named below that are not listed on this page. Each hotel below shows every site's all-in price. Taxes and fees at Bangkok hotels

At the 10 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 7% ($8 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 5% at Hotel Royal Bangkok to 18% at JC Kevin Sathorn Bangkok Hotel. At 5 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
